title: /help, /help/<category> and /help/changelog shared as the homepage: they set no openGraph of their own and inherited the root block whole

source.ref: found 2026-10-05 by the scan-seven SEO/GEO finders (26-agent fan-out), confirmed by hand against the tree

detail: FOUND 2026-10-05 (scan seven, four independent finders: seo-metadata, seo-social, seo-help, seo-urls). Next replaces nested metadata objects rather than merging them: a page that sets no openGraph inherits the root's og:url "/", homepage title and description, so a shared help link previewed as the homepage. The help ARTICLE page set its own openGraph and so lost og:site_name and og:locale instead. CLOSED 2026-10-05: the three pages carry their own openGraph (type, siteName, locale, title, description, url) and the article block adds siteName and locale. The site-wide version of the second half (every page that sets openGraph drops site_name/locale) is a sweep and stays open as SCAN-659.

verify.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const q=String.fromCharCode(39);const pages={"app/(help)/help/page.tsx":"/help","app/(help)/help/[category]/page.tsx":"/help/${cat.slug}","app/(help)/help/changelog/page.tsx":"/help/changelog"};for(const [p,u] of Object.entries(pages)){const s=fs.readFileSync(p,"utf8");const i=s.indexOf("openGraph:");const want="url: "+(u.includes("$")?"`"+u+"`":q+u+q);if(i<0||!s.slice(i).includes(want)){console.error("SCAN-657: "+p+" sets no openGraph of its own, so it inherits the ROOT block whole and shares as the homepage (og:url /, homepage title).");process.exit(1)}}const a=fs.readFileSync("app/(help)/help/[category]/[slug]/page.tsx","utf8");if(!/siteName: SITE_NAME/.test(a)){console.error("SCAN-657: the help article openGraph drops og:site_name, because Next replaces nested metadata objects rather than merging them.");process.exit(1)}'
verify.note: Fails on main before this change (checked by stashing the fix); passes with it.
